properties.name: Fort Belknap Transit
properties.units: Fort Belknap Reservation and Off-Reservation Trust Land
properties.note: Fort Belknap Indian Reservation (Blaine/Phillips counties, MT); tribal boundary aiannh='Fort Belknap' confirmed correct. CSV pin (48.5310,-108.7773) sits at/near Harlem, which is just NORTH of the Milk River — the reservation's natural north boundary — while the reservation's largest community, Fort Belknap Agency, is immediately south of the river; this places the pin ~3.6km outside the polygon even though the boundary match itself is correct. Likely a CSV geocoding issue (pin should be Fort Belknap Agency, not Harlem), not a spec error — see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Belknap_Agency,_Montana and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Belknap_Indian_Reservation.
